name: @bytesell/slurp-runtime
description: Optional browser runtime for Slurp themes: client navigation, {fetch} data loading and infinite scroll.
author: ByteSell LLC
//exports: Do not promote experimental/fetch and experimental/infinite to ./fetch and ./infinite until the compiler emits the markers they bind to. See DECISIONS.md.
//dependencies: tailwind-merge 3 is what makes `cn()` target Tailwind CSS v4, so it states a consumer-facing contract rather than an internal version: `cn` is exported from the package root AND published on `window`. The unit tests only exercise utilities that behave identically across tailwind-merge majors, so they cannot catch a change here. Moving major means restating the supported Tailwind version in README.md.
